mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 33 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 spring election, where all four aldermanic district seats will be on the ballot. Interested candidates must submit their paperwork to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and a craft brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a notable incident from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle. The incident resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is opening today at 10:00 AM, serving up the delicious Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day.
